notes.title: Unveils New Demo for Steam Next Fest June 2025
notes.content: [p]Fellow mates,[/p][p][/p][p]We are proud to announce that [b][i]Gurei[/i][/b], the hand-drawn action-platformer will be featured in the June 2025 Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3776080/Gurei_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Inspired by classic Japanese chambara cinema, [i]Gurei[/i] invites you to embody Rei, a human spirit on a mission to defeat the mystical Kami and absorb their powers.[/p][p]The game’s nonlinear boss structure and dynamic difficulty system ensure that each encounter is shaped by your choice, offering a unique challenge with every playthrough.[/p][p]With each victory, Rei gains new abilities, along with unexpected piece of stories and commentaries from the defeated Kami, enriching the narrative and gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220560/a9d043c76a12017618d44ab2614b882ff4eabe33.png"][/img][/p][p]As always, we’d love to hear your feedback in the forums or Discord.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GqvKQWrMve"]https://discord.gg/GqvKQWrMve[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The [i]Gurei[/i] Team[/p][p]2025.6.6[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Happy Lunar new year from Gurei
notes.content:
Fellow mates,

From January 27th to February 10th, [i]Gurei[/i] will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at Lobo Sagaz Studio extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community.

As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on [i]Gurei[/i]. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191280/_/

[i]Gurei[/i] is an unforgiving game with fast-paced combat. Fight challenging bosses in any order, acquire their unique powers and succeed in your own terms.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

The [i]Gurei[/i] Team

notes.title: Gurei is now taking part in Steam China Showcase 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220560/8e87cc0b84642ec0fec9c9da927833bf221baf37.jpg[/img]
Dear Players,

We're excited to participate in the Steam China Showcase hosted by Steam China!

We will be taking advantage of this fantastic opportunity to show case our upcoming game, Gurei.

We are progressing well into the development. Though at this moment we don’t have a demo available, we are confident that we should have something for our followers in the near future! Please stay tuned! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191280/Gurei/

Don't forget to add Gurei to your wishlist if you're interested. It's a huge boost and support for us!

Make sure to check out the featured Steam Page for the Steam China Showcase as well! 

The Development Team
September 22, 2023

Link to the featured page of Steam China Showcase:

notes.title: Gurei at BitSummit 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220560/fa5e0ee056f81aa17be8b38db3e88a65956630a6.png[/img]
Hello, samurai

We're excited to participate in the "BitSummit Let’sGo!!" event!

We are progressing well into the development. Though at this moment we don’t have a demo available, we are confident that we should have something for our followers in the near future!

This is an action game inspired by samurai films, is fully hand-drawn, with a combat system that has both fluid and impactful controls, and has a high difficulty ceiling.

Link to the featured page of BitSummit Let’sGo!!:
